reviews.quote:
I have had the privilege of working with Jair Ribeiro for several years at Volvo Group, and I can confidently say he is one of the most visionary leaders in AI I have encountered. When I hired Jair, I knew he brought strong technical expertise, but what truly impressed me over time was his ability to combine deep analytical knowledge with strategic thinking and a collaborative mindset.

Jair consistently demonstrates a passion for leveraging data and AI to create real business value. He has a unique talent for translating complex concepts into actionable insights that drive innovation and efficiency. Beyond his technical skills, Jair is an inspiring leader who fosters teamwork, encourages curiosity, and empowers those around him to grow.

If you are looking for someone who can lead transformative initiatives in AI while building strong relationships across the organization, I wholeheartedly recommend Jair Ribeiro.

reviews.name: Florian Urbański
reviews.relationship: Worked with Jair at different companies
reviews.role: Senior Analyst – Credit & Collections, Solventum
reviews.quote:
In the name of the WrOpenUp Foundation I want to thank you for volunteering for WrOpenUp Edition 2019!

Thank you very much for volunteering as Program Manager!

Your willingness to spend your private time for this project of Corporate Social Responsibility is very much appreciated. By sharing your experience and skills to enable workshops in the fields of Cross-Cultural Competence, Project Management and Presentation Skills to over 400 Students you helped us to raise intercultural competence and cultural tolerance among Polish teenagers from Wrocław. Furthermore, your engagement enabled us to deliver necessary skills in a globalized and diverse working environment to the teenager for their future career.

WrOpenUp Foundation aims to promote tolerance towards intercultural differences, help in breaking stereotypes, and support integration through education of young leaders. Organization’s primary focus are the people of Wroclaw – citizens, students, schoolchildren and ex-pats employed locally as well as institutions – corporations, schools and city authorities. The main tool used in achieving WrOpenUp statutory goals are set of workshops, primarily Cross Cultural Competencies, Presentation Skills, Project Management skills, Leadership skills and Competitions along with educational trips.

Thank you for making this edition of WrOpenUp so successful.

reviews.name: César Garcia
reviews.relationship: LinkedIn recommendation relationship: teacher; worked together at IBM
reviews.role: IT Digital Cloud Manager, Hapag-Lloyd AG
reviews.quote:
Firstly, it is essential highlighting that Jair impresses by his enthusiasm, energy and very positive attitude. I had the great pleasure of working with him, during the period we were both in IBM. I was thrilled to see how much he was involved in the activities connected with diversity in integration, firstly in the company, in later in the whole city. He brought new ideas, new energy and was interesting to see how the group move to a new level.

When it comes to cognitive technologies, he became outstanding in inspiring and disseminating knowledge to the most different levels of the business, and I have no doubts he already a notable influencer in the organization he currently supports.

I sincerely recommend him, and he certainly will be an asset whenever he focuses his potential.

reviews.name: Aneta Dlugopolska-Mikonowicz
reviews.relationship: Worked with Jair on the same team
reviews.role: Leadership & Organizational Development Director Europe & Africa, Lear Corporation | President, WrOpenUp Foundation
reviews.quote:
In the name of WrOpenUp Foundation we would like to thank Jair for amazing skills-based volunteering engagement since 2016. During this period Jair has been developing educational programs in the area of project management and presentation skills for students of junior high and high schools in Wrocław, as well as recruiting and coordinating other skills-based volunteers. In 2018 edition he led the development of the - Leadership Skills for young leaders - workshop scenario; including such aspects as responsibility, empathy, intercultural awareness and tools empowering youth to take action for the sake of the society they live in.

To this day he conducted also numerous Train The Trainer sessions for volunteering trainers, has trained himself several hundred students and teachers in mentioned areas. He also participated in educational projects related to interculturalism organized by the Municipality of Wrocław and shared both his impressive business experience and his values with students of the University of Economics in Wroclaw as WrOpenUp ambassador.

He exceeded all expectations.

It is real honor and pleasure to work with Jair and to learn from him how to manage and create complex programs and dynamic structures, such as teams of skills-based volunteers from diverse cultures and organisations. His engagement and enjoyment of the most challenging situations are truly contagious and motivated the whole WrOpenUp team of volunteers which really adores to work with him.

Jair is the role model leader of the future.

WrOpenUp is a cross-sector project based in the City of Wrocław in Poland, supported by Municipality and local subsidiaries of multinational corporations and is both promoting openness to cultural diversity and developing future works skills with intercultural competence, responsibility and empathy in heart.

Thank you for making this WrOpenUp so successful!!

One can easily recognize people that stand out in your working environment, people that are not just coming to work to complete the task and go home, but the people with passion, enthusiasm, love for what they are doing, vision where technology and work are heading and a joy to be there, participate and heavily contribute.

That kind of a person and a team member is Jair. It is hard not to be engaged and trilled when you see someone with such passion not only talking about things that could be done, but also digging deep with hands on attitude.

Jair will sit down, learn about topic, test it, do it, and will act from there having actual experience and knowledge. He will do first then talk. He will engage your team and move things forward.

But also, he will never forget his daily obligation and work that has to be done.

I am proud to know Jair and can recommend him for any team that needs an experienced, knowledgeable, hands-on member with great attitude, sense of humor and joy for life.

Thank you Jair!
Marko.
